summary: A hiker was lost in the Blue Lakes area near North Peak and Greenhorn Mountain in the Wet Mountains; Pueblo County SAR ran the incident, stayed in cell-phone contact with the subject, and called in Custer County SAR (3 members as advisors/backup hasty team) plus Flight for Life, which located the subject from the air. The hiker was extracted unharmed and returned to their vehicle; CCSAR was released at 17:47.
location: Blue Lakes area near North Peak and Greenhorn Mountain, Wet Mountains
responding_agency: Pueblo County SAR (incident command); Custer County SAR assist; Flight for Life
notes: CCSAR past-missions entry "Pueblo County assist near Blue Lakes": paged 15:36 on 2019-06-30, subject located by Flight for Life overhead search. Date 2019-06-30 = Sunday (America/Denver).
